alcohol-units.name: Alcohol Units and Blood Alcohol Content Calculator
alcohol-units.intro: Convert drinks to standard alcohol units and estimate blood alcohol content (BAC) from body weight, sex and drinking time, with the hourly metabolism offset applied.

blood-pressure-classifier.name: Blood Pressure Category Classifier
blood-pressure-classifier.intro: Classify a systolic/diastolic reading into normal, elevated or hypertension stages, and show pulse pressure and mean arterial pressure alongside tailored advice.

blood-sugar-converter.name: Blood Glucose Unit Converter (mmol/L to mg/dL)
blood-sugar-converter.intro: Convert blood glucose between mmol/L and mg/dL using the glucose molar-mass factor of 18, and compare the reading against fasting and post-meal reference ranges.

blood-type-calculator.name: Blood Type Inheritance Calculator
blood-type-calculator.intro: Work out the possible ABO and Rh blood types of a child from the parents' blood types, with the probability of each outcome based on Mendelian inheritance.

body-fat-calculator.name: Body Fat Percentage Calculator
body-fat-calculator.intro: Estimate body fat percentage with the US Navy circumference method, the BMI method, skinfold sums or bioelectrical impedance, then rate the result against age and sex bands.

body-surface-area.name: Body Surface Area (BSA) Calculator
body-surface-area.intro: Compute body surface area with the Mosteller, Du Bois and Haycock formulas from height and weight, and see how the three estimates compare for drug dosing contexts.

breath-timer.name: Guided Breathing Timer
breath-timer.intro: Run a paced breathing session with configurable inhale, hold and exhale phases - the 4-7-8 relaxing pattern included - and track completed cycles.

caffeine-limit.name: Daily Caffeine Limit Calculator
caffeine-limit.intro: Estimate a safe daily caffeine ceiling from body weight and population group, convert it into cups of coffee, and log drinks against the running total.

calc-1.name: Daily Water Intake Recommendation
calc-1.intro: Estimate how much water to drink each day from body weight, exercise minutes and climate, then spread the total across a practical hourly drinking schedule.

calc-2.name: Sleep Quality Score
calc-2.intro: Score sleep quality across duration, sleep latency, night wakings, depth, daytime alertness and breathing, and turn the total into an actionable improvement plan.

calc-3.name: Screen Time Assessment
calc-3.intro: Add up daily hours on phone, computer, TV and tablet, compare the total with age-group recommendations, and flag eye-strain and sleep risks.

calorie-needs.name: Daily Calorie Needs Calculator
calorie-needs.intro: Calculate basal metabolic rate and total daily energy expenditure from age, height, weight, body fat and activity level, then derive target calories for weight goals.

child-bmi-calculator.name: Child and Teen BMI Calculator
child-bmi-calculator.intro: Compute BMI for ages 2-20 and interpret it with age- and sex-specific percentile and z-score bands, plus an ideal weight range for the child's height.

child-height-predictor.name: Child Adult Height Predictor
child-height-predictor.intro: Predict a child's adult height from the mid-parental height formula with the sex adjustment, and give the expected range around the target.

child-medication-dose.name: Child Medication Dose Calculator
child-medication-dose.intro: Scale an adult dose down to a child with Clark's weight rule and Young's age rule, and compare both against the standard mg/kg dosing range for the selected drug.

cholesterol-ratio.name: Cholesterol Ratio Calculator
cholesterol-ratio.intro: Compute the total/HDL, LDL/HDL and triglyceride/HDL ratios plus non-HDL cholesterol, and map the total/HDL ratio onto cardiovascular risk levels.

dumbbell-weight-calculator.name: Dumbbell and Barbell Plate Calculator
dumbbell-weight-calculator.intro: Work out which plates to load on each side to reach a target barbell weight, given the bar weight and the plate sizes available in your gym.

dysphagia-food-guide.name: Dysphagia Food Texture Guide
dysphagia-food-guide.intro: Browse foods graded by dysphagia diet levels so you can pick textures that match the prescribed swallowing safety level for each meal.

fracture-healing.name: Fracture Healing Timeline Reference
fracture-healing.intro: Look up typical healing times and immobilisation periods for common fractures by bone and age group, to set expectations for recovery milestones.

gfr-calculator.name: eGFR Kidney Function Calculator
gfr-calculator.intro: Estimate glomerular filtration rate with MDRD, CKD-EPI or Cockcroft-Gault from serum creatinine, age, sex and body size, and stage the result by CKD category.

ibw-calculator.name: Ideal Body Weight Calculator
ibw-calculator.intro: Compute ideal body weight with the Devine formula and related methods, then show adjusted body weight, the gap against actual weight and the corresponding BMI.

insulin-dose.name: Mealtime Insulin Dose Calculator
insulin-dose.intro: Estimate a prandial insulin dose from carbohydrate intake and the insulin-to-carb ratio, add a correction dose from the insulin sensitivity factor, and subtract active insulin.

milk-tea-calories.name: Milk Tea Calorie Estimator
milk-tea-calories.intro: Add up the calories in a cup of milk tea from cup size, tea base, milk type, sugar level and toppings such as boba, pudding or cheese foam.

one-rep-max.name: One-Rep Max (1RM) Calculator
one-rep-max.intro: Estimate your one-rep max from a weight lifted for reps, compare several established formulas, and derive training loads as percentages of 1RM.

ovulation-calculator.name: Ovulation and Fertile Window Calculator
ovulation-calculator.intro: Estimate the ovulation day from the last period and cycle length, then mark the fertile window and the相对 safe days on a calendar view.

pace-calculator.name: Running Pace Calculator
pace-calculator.intro: Convert between pace, distance and finish time, and read off the average speed in km/h or mph for any running or walking workout.

pregnancy-due-date.name: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
pregnancy-due-date.intro: Estimate a due date from the last period, ovulation date or ultrasound measurement, and track current gestational week, day and trimester milestones.

pregnancy-weight-gain.name: Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator
pregnancy-weight-gain.intro: Suggest total and weekly pregnancy weight gain ranges from pre-pregnancy BMI using the IOM 2009 guideline, so you can manage gestational weight sensibly.
pregnancy-weight-gain.zh: 孕期体重增长建议计算器

premature-age-calculator.name: Corrected Age Calculator for Preterm Babies
premature-age-calculator.intro: Compute corrected age for a preterm infant from gestational age at birth, and compare growth and development against corrected rather than chronological age.

protein-needs.name: Daily Protein Intake Calculator
protein-needs.intro: Estimate daily protein requirements from body weight, activity level and goal such as muscle gain or fat loss, with an age adjustment for older adults.

rehab-timer.name: Rehabilitation Exercise Timer
rehab-timer.intro: Build a timed rehab circuit from custom exercise, set and rest durations, and run it with audible cues so home therapy sessions stay on schedule.

running-calories.name: Running Calorie Burn Calculator
running-calories.intro: Estimate calories burned while running from pace, distance and body weight using MET values, or switch to the heart-rate method for a personalised figure.

safe-period-calculator.name: Safe Period Calculator
safe-period-calculator.intro: Estimate fertile and safe period windows from the calendar method: ovulation falls about 14 days before the next period, with a five-day buffer either side.

sleep-cycle-calculator.name: Sleep Cycle Calculator
sleep-cycle-calculator.intro: Work backwards from your wake time - or forwards from bedtime - to find the 90-minute sleep cycle boundaries, so you wake at the end of a cycle rather than mid-cycle.

smoking-cost-calculator.name: Smoking Cost Calculator
smoking-cost-calculator.intro: Total up what smoking costs per day, month, year and over a chosen number of years, and translate the habit into packs bought and life expectancy lost.

stretch-generator.name: Random Stretch Routine Generator
stretch-generator.intro: Generate a random stretching routine filtered by target area such as neck, shoulders or hips, for a quick desk break or a post-workout cool-down.

symptom-checker.name: Symptom Checker Decision Tree
symptom-checker.intro: Walk a symptom decision tree that narrows common presentations into likely categories and urgency levels, to help decide whether to rest, self-care or see a doctor.

vo2-max-calculator.name: VO2 Max Calculator
vo2-max-calculator.intro: Estimate VO2 max from a Cooper 12-minute run, a 1.5-mile run time or a treadmill Bruce protocol stage, then grade the result against age and sex norms.

waist-hip-ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR) Calculator
waist-hip-ratio.intro: Compute waist-to-hip ratio and classify central obesity risk by sex thresholds, with optional BMI and waist-to-height ratio for a fuller body-shape picture.

water-intake-calculator.name: Daily Water Intake Calculator
water-intake-calculator.intro: Calculate recommended daily water intake from body weight with age-specific millilitres per kilogram, then adjust for activity, weather and special conditions.

wound-healing-time.name: Wound Healing Time Estimator
wound-healing-time.intro: Estimate how long a wound takes to heal from its type, size and location, and see the healing stages and warning signs that warrant medical review.
